description: Oh no! The old dryer is smoking. Not metaphorically.
option_1: Keep running it with the door open
option_2: Unplug it and start the replacement
option_3: Gut the laundry room and start over

description: You pull the dryer out. The wall behind it is brown, warm, and a little bit proud of itself.
option_1: Cover it with a framed poster
option_2: Replace the scorched drywall and check the insulation
option_3: Rebuild the whole laundry room wall

description: The dryer plug has fused to the outlet. It's modern art now.
option_1: Pry it out with a screwdriver
option_2: Have an electrician replace the outlet and cord

description: Behind the dryer: a lint ecosystem with its own weather.
option_1: Blow it into the next room
option_2: Vacuum it up and clean out the vent
option_3: Hire a duct cleaner for the whole house

description: The foil vent hose is folded flat like a sad accordion. No wonder it smoked.
option_2: Replace it with rigid metal duct
option_3: Replace all the ductwork in the house

description: The vent runs into the wall next to the dryer, and it's packed solid in there. Somebody has to look.
option_1: Poke a coat hanger in and hope

description: A low hum. Then a very large honeycomb, and its very concerned owners.
option_2: Call a beekeeper to remove the colony

description: Behind the hive: years of honey soaked into the drywall and insulation. It's sticky. It's everywhere.
option_2: Cut out the damp section and replace it
option_3: Gut the whole wall and rebuild

description: Opening the wall made a snowstorm. It's in the vents, the couch, and the dog.
option_1: Sweep it into the next room
option_2: Seal off the area and clean with a HEPA vacuum
option_3: Pay for a whole-house deep clean

description: Your new dryer has a four-prong cord. Your outlet has three. The adapter says 'not recommended' in four languages.
option_1: Run it off an extension cord
option_3: Swap the dryer's cord for a three-prong kit

description: The new dryer is two inches wider than the alcove. Of course it is.
option_2: Return it for one that fits

description: Sliding out the old dryer took a chunk of the floor with it.
option_3: Replace the flooring in the whole room

event: The cat is in the vent
description: From deep inside the duct, a very small, very smug meow.
option_1: Run the dryer to coax him out
option_2: Cut an opening and gently rescue the cat

description: Outside, the vent flap is stuffed with a bird's nest. The bird is not leaving.
option_1: Poke it clear with a stick and walk away
option_2: Clean it and replace the vent cap
option_3: Reroute the vent through the roof

description: The alcove is tall. A stacked washer and dryer would free up so much floor.
option_1: Balance the dryer on top of the washer
option_2: Put it on the next project's list
option_3: Rebuild the alcove tonight for stacking

description: The store has a dryer that texts you when the cycle ends. It also has opinions about the weather.
option_1: Keep the smoking one, it's basically fine
option_2: Buy the basic model as planned
option_3: Buy the smart one with the app and the subscription

description: Your partner: "While the dryer's out, that shelf above it is crooked."
option_1: Leave the machine in pieces and fix it now
option_2: Fix it once the dryer is hooked up
option_3: Build a laundry room with custom cabinets
